body: May dignity issue hidden inside a simple claim form. A benefit can legally exist yet psychologically feel inaccessible kapag ang recipient ay pagod, nahihiya humingi, takot sa scam, o overwhelmed sa paperwork. So ‘low effort’ administratively does not always mean low friction humanly. Magandang family practice: treat official letters for older relatives as shared household responsibility, not proof na ‘dapat kaya na nila yan.’ Assistance can preserve autonomy when it helps someone exercise a right rather than taking control away.

claims.text: Administrative simplicity does not necessarily eliminate psychological or practical barriers for older recipients.
claims.basis: Human-centered interpretation of a targeted, deadline-dependent benefit process
